checks.evidence: Vite dev server started at http://localhost:5199/. Browser opened the page; accessibility tree showed time text in format 'NN时:NN分:NN秒'. First snapshot at ~11:11:50 displayed '11时:11分:50秒'; system date at that point was 11:11:56. Second read ~14s later displayed '11时:12分:04秒'; system date was 11:12:10. The seconds advanced by 14 (50→04 crossing minute boundary), matching elapsed time. The displayed time aligned with system time within expected read latency. No user interaction required.
